svg.title: Pushbutton with Pull-down
svg.desc: A breadboard wiring view of Pushbutton with Pull-down, on a half-size board of 30 columns with rows a–e above the central trough and f–j below it, and continuous power rails top and bottom. 3 parts are placed at their own tie points: uno (mcu uno), sw1 (button), r1 (resistor 10k). 6 jumper wires run as smooth arcs in their net colours, each landing exactly on a hole. Off-board modules are drawn as labelled blocks with the pins they actually use on the edge facing the board.

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Arduino digital input: button applies 5 V and a 10 kΩ resistor holds the input low when open
